messages:
sarah.ops: Heads up — provider pushed an emergency peering change in ap-south1. Seeing asymmetric routing causing TLS handshake failures at our edgeproxy. Spike in GPU attach 502s and controller attach timeouts. Notifying oncall.
cloud-status-bot: Provider status: emergency peering change in ap-south1 impacting asymmetric routes and TCP session stability for some customers.
mike.sre: Confirming 502s on POST /v1/instances/attach in ap-south1-gpu pool. Controller logs: "tls handshake: remote error: internal error" and "attach timeout". Node metrics (CPU/disk) look normal.
dinesh.net: BGP view shows our AS prepended on several paths; some traffic exits via edgeproxy1 and returns via transit-gw -> asymmetric NAT breaks TLS. Short term: either force egress via transit-gw (route targets) or shift control-plane/attach traffic to neighboring region.
sarah.ops: Mitigation plan: enable routing flag `egress-strict: transit-preferred` for ap-south1 control-plane to prefer transit-gw for K8s/controller egress. Rolling to 10% of ap-south1 now.
oncall-bot: sarah.ops escalated to P1 — paging mike.sre.
leah-platform: Can we cold-start dedicated capacity in eu-west3 and prefer that for new attaches? Cost hit estimate: ~+15% egress, +30% infra while scaled. We have spare dedicated there.
mike.sre: Starting fast upscale: provisioning 20 GPUs in eu-west3 dedicated pool. Also switching fallback model variants to smaller kv-cache quantized build to reduce attach/control-plane traffic. Updating placement policy shortly.
sarah.ops: Also enabling local KMS envelope-key cache for controller startup (10m TTL) to allow attaches while KMS path flaps. Note: this delays key rotation and slightly increases risk surface; recommended for emergency only. Approve?
dinesh.net: Approve for 10m. Ensure we still emit audit logs and reconcile when KMS back. Pushing cache policy in 5m.
rohit-eng: Adding temporary VPN route to eu transit for health-check/control-plane only: `terraform apply -target=module.vpn.ap_south1` (ran). This reduces control-plane egress via the broken peering.
mike.sre: Attach error rate moved 18% -> 7% after egress-strict + VPN health-checks. New attach latency for eu-west3 flows improved 14s -> 6s. Still seeing ~1-2% TLS handshake failures for local attaches.
sarah.ops: Decision: shift 60% of new attach traffic to eu-west3, keep 40% local with aggressive retries. Anticipated cost increase ~+$12k/day. Leah/finance OK?
leah-platform: Finance notified in incident channel; verbal ok for now, will record charge to incident cost center.
cloud-status-bot: Provider update: peering rollback initiated, expected convergence in ~45m.
mike.sre: Preparing rollback: plan is remove `egress-strict`, drain eu-west3 to normal scale, revert placement policies, and keep KMS cache for 15m after provider says converged.
sarah.ops: Action items (post-incident): 1) Add automatic detection alert for asymmetric AS path (BGP AS mismatch) 2) KMS cache safe-mode runbook + automated guardrails 3) Cost-threshold automation for cross-region attach shift. Owners: dinesh.net, rohit-eng, leah-platform. Postmortem owner: sarah.ops.
oncall-bot: Current metrics: attach error rate 2%, new attach latency 3.8s. Waiting provider confirmation to close.
sarah.ops: Closing main incident thread once provider confirms rollback and we finish follow-ups. Will open a follow-up ticket for retrospective and cost reconciliation. :thumbsup:
__notes: thread-style single string, messages in chronological order, Slack-like abbreviations and bots included
